morphology.pattern_note: 本条按族名Miao处理，整词记忆，正文首字母大写；没有可据所给材料确认的马来语派生词。音标为不标汉语声调的宽式读音提示，非DBP核定音标。

senses.zh_definition: 苗族：中国民族分类中的一个民族，主要分布于中国南方，内部包含具有不同自称、语言和文化传统的群体；也指其成员。
senses.en_definition: The Miao, an ethnic group recognized in China, comprising several communities concentrated mainly in southern China; a member of this group.
senses.ms_definition: Kumpulan etnik yang diiktiraf di China, terutama di bahagian selatan negara itu, atau anggota kumpulan tersebut.
senses.nuances: 输入缺少定义和语境，本条据可核实的马来文族名用法编写；马来文释义为编辑释义，并非DBP引文。标准正文写Miao，常见于etnik Miao等结构。[BERNAMA用例](https://www.bernama.com/bm/tintaminda/news.php?id=2359348)。Miao是较广的分类名称，Hmong属于与其相关的具体身份名称，二者不宜在所有语境中直接互换。[Smithsonian说明](https://festival.si.edu/blog/2014/a-reunion-of-ancient-cultural-roots)。

dual_scenarios.ms: Pameran itu memperkenalkan seni sulaman masyarakat Miao di Guizhou kepada pengunjung.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该展览向参观者介绍贵州苗族的刺绣艺术。
dual_scenarios.en: The exhibition introduces visitors to the embroidery traditions of Miao communities in Guizhou.

messages.speaker: Mei Ling (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak tengok pameran sulaman Miao tu esok. Kau nak ikut?
messages.ms_standard: Saya hendak melihat pameran sulaman Miao itu esok. Adakah awak hendak ikut?

messages.en: I'm planning to see that Miao embroidery exhibition tomorrow. Want to come?

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Nak! Aku dah tengok gambar sulaman tu, cantik betul.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya hendak ikut. Saya sudah melihat gambar sulaman itu; sulaman itu sangat cantik.
messages.zh: 要！我已经看过那些刺绣的照片了，真的很漂亮。
messages.en: Yes! I've seen photos of the embroidery. It's beautiful.

etymology.historical_story: Miao represents the Chinese ethnic designation 苗 in Latin script. In Malay cultural reporting, the name often appears alongside Guizhou and its embroidery traditions. Embroidered clothing can carry community history, values, and distinctive motifs. The broader label includes communities with different identities, so its cultural richness is best understood through particular places and people. [Smithsonian](https://asia-archive.si.edu/learn/for-educators/teaching-china-with-the-smithsonian/videos/miao-embroidery/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Miao读起来接近“苗”：把这个声音与一件苗绣服饰连起来，记住“苗族”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 马来文文化报道中可用etnik Miao或masyarakat Miao。与个人交谈时，沿用对方认可的族群自称，体现尊重。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合民族文化、旅游和历史介绍。说明具体社群时，宜补充地区或自称，避免把所有苗族社群描述成具有完全相同的语言和习俗。
